sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed on monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title 
block.

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Saady Ahmed Mohamed Yahie, tested by eng. 
Ibrahem Mohamed Abdel Rahman, accepted by eng.Hassan Refaie Hessain general 
director, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel Abd EL-Qader El Nagar, and approved by eng. Fawzy 
Sobhy Ismaiel 
Head Sector of Abu Sultan PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & inspection and 
 quality control general director, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.

Circuit Breaker must be out of service and on the 
 open position
Draw out the circuit breaker.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Safety and healthy equipment
Complete kit of tools,
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.
Blower, Voltmeter
Work to be Carried Out
Visually look for a dirt grease or other foreign material on any breaker parts.
Check for any loosen component of breaker or wiring

Observe a few nos. of close-open operations using the operating or maintenance 
handle.

Verify the safety interlocks (racking mechanism, positive, closing spring, 
disconnect position, pad locks, and optional interlocks key, door interlocks ) 
are properly working.
Inspect the condition of the arc chutes and contacts.
Look for excessive burning or leakage.

Check all protection 
devices by protection staff.
Return the breaker into service with coordination with shift engineer.
